definition.description: Retrieves audit records for a customer from Microsoft Partner Center API within a specified date range. Returns raw audit data without parsing due to dynamic structure.

inputFields.helpText: The unique identifier (GUID) of the customer in Partner Center.
Start date for the audit record query. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss
End date for the audit record query. Format: MM/DD/YYYY HH:mm:ss
Bearer token for Partner Center API authentication. Typically obtained from an OAuth node.

outputParameters.description: Total number of audit records returned by the API
Number of items in the response array
The full raw JSON response body (unparsed due to dynamic structure)
HTTP status code from the API response
True if an error occurred during the request
Error details if the request failed

connectionTags.description: Triggered when audit records were successfully retrieved
Triggered when the request fails or returns an error status
